name: gap-dubai-pobox-trn
description: Dubai building-materials trading L.L.C. card carried by an Indian expat (very common in the app's market). Front: Arabic company line OCR'd as junk by the eng model, ALL-CAPS company with 'L.L.C.' written with dots, name with a single trailing initial 'Mohammed Faisal K.', 'Sales Executive', UAE-format phones with spaces ('+971 50 123 4567' mobile, '+971 4 267 8899' landline, fax), an Indian WhatsApp number on its own labelled line ('WhatsApp (India) : +91 98450 12345' — must classify as mobile), '.ae' e-mail and website. Back: 'P.O. Box 12345, Deira, Dubai, U.A.E.' address with NO street and NO postal code (P.O. Box is the address), 'TRN : 100123456700003' — a 15-digit VAT number that passes a naive 7..15-digit phone guard, and 'Trade Lic. No. 654321' — a bare 6-digit code that is NOT an Indian PIN.
